definitions.explanation: A cord or strap worn around the neck to hold something such as an ID card, key, smartphone, or whistle.

examples.japanese: {社員証|しゃいんしょう}を{首紐|くびひも}でぶら{下|さ}げる。
examples.english: I hang my employee ID from a neck strap.

examples.japanese: スマホに{首紐|くびひも}をつけて{落|お}とさないようにしている。
examples.english: I attach a neck strap to my smartphone so I don't drop it.

examples.japanese: {展示会場|てんじかいじょう}では{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}{全員|ぜんいん}に{首紐|くびひも}つきの{名札|なふだ}が{配|くば}られた。
examples.english: At the exhibition venue, neck-strap nametags were distributed to every visitor.

notes:
Compound of {首|くび} (neck) + {紐|ひも} (cord, string).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首紐|くびひも}をつける: to attach a neck strap
- {首紐|くびひも}でぶら{下|さ}げる: to hang from a neck strap
- {首紐|くびひも}つきの{名札|なふだ}: a nametag with a neck strap
- スマホ{首紐|くびひも}: smartphone neck strap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ストラップ: strap — broader loanword for any kind of strap (wrist, neck, bag)
- ネックストラップ: neck strap — the katakana equivalent, common on product labels
- ランヤード: lanyard — used mainly in safety or industrial contexts
